sender: Priya Natarajan, Software Channel Research, Halberd Lane Partners
subject: MSFT channel check: Azure reseller demand running ahead of plan
body: Hi team, Quick read from this week's reseller calls. Our checks with four Azure resellers point to Intelligent Cloud revenue growth of 26% in FY2027, versus the 21.5% the Street models. Two of the resellers said new GPU capacity in the Iowa and Texas regions was released to customers six weeks early. Both expect larger enterprise commitments in the December quarter now that the waitlists are clearing. We have not changed our rating. Full notes to follow. Priya

subject: Alphabet nears 1.2 GW power deal with Midwest utility for data centers
body: Morning, Local press and two regulatory filings indicate Alphabet is close to signing a 1.2 gigawatt power purchase agreement with a Midwest utility to supply new data center campuses from 2028. We see this as part of the broader hyperscaler scramble for power and are watching for confirmation at the utility's investor day next month. Hannah Brooks Pell River Securities

sender: Diego Alvarez, Cloud Infrastructure Research, Tamsin Ridge Capital
subject: AMZN: in-house chips now carry a large share of internal inference
body: Team, From two conversations this week with AWS infrastructure partners: Amazon has moved roughly 40% of its internal model inference onto its own Trainium chips, up from under 15% a year ago. One partner also said AWS is pricing Trainium instances at about a 30% discount to comparable GPU instances to pull external customers across. If that holds, AWS's cost of AI capacity falls faster than the market assumes. We are not aware of this being discussed on the Street. Diego
